children: Barclays raised its year-end target for the S&P 500 index
to 7,950 from 7,800 on Wednesday, citing strong tech-led earnings and durable AI-driven growth.
While earnings outlook has improved, "we remain conservative on valuations given resilient inflation, geopolitical uncertainty and a more hawkish rate outlook," the brokerage said in a note.
